title: Optimizer Suggestion Pilot Coordinator with Escalation and Backstop
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a coordinator service and control-plane workflow that safely automates applying Optimize batching/caching recommendations. The coordinator will run pre-apply safety checks, schedule canary ramps across selected customer segments, surface operator approvals for risky changes, provide automated rollback/backstop policies, and emit rich telemetry for post-apply verification. Goal: reduce manual effort for low-risk recs while guaranteeing fast, auditable rollback and operator visibility for high-risk cases.
tasks: Design coordinator API and policy model (intake, candidate scoring, canary plan)
Implement simulated-traffic validator with synthetic trace replay
Add operator acknowledgement UI hooks in Console for 'Escalate / Approve / Hold'
Build staged deployment engine (percent-based ramps + region targeting)
Instrument metrics and build smoke tests for cost/regression detection
Implement automatic backstop rollback triggers and human-in-loop override
acceptance_criteria: Coordinator exposes an API to ingest Optimize suggestions and returns a safe/unsafe recommendation with rationale
Canary plan can be created targeting 0.5%/1%/5%/20% traffic increments with region and model variant constraints
Simulated-traffic validator produces a failure signal < 1 minute and blocks rollout if quality regressions exceed threshold
Console shows pending approvals with links to diffs, cost delta, and simulated impact report
Automated rollback triggers on either latency SLO degradation (>10% p50) or quality regression (measured via evals) and records audit event
comments: 2025-02-10 - Aisha Patel: Kicked off ticket after design sync with PM and Research. We tracked recurring manual work where engineers approve trivial batching suggestions; aim is to automate those while keeping strong guardrails.

2025-02-18 - Mateo Gomez: Initial API sketch done. Proposal: POST /coordinator/suggestions -> returns {id, risk_score, suggested_plan}. Risk score derived from historical rollout signal, model family sensitivity, and customer tier.

2025-03-05 - Engineering notes (Mateo): Implementing validator by reusing the 'traffic-replay' harness from the runtime team. Need a safe sandbox cluster for simulated runs to avoid billing customers.
2025-03-10 - Security (Rohit Verma): Confirmed KMS key is required for storing signed rollout manifests; will run security review. Marking security_review_required=true.
2025-03-14 - QA (Elena Rodriguez): Integration tests passing on feature branch. Canary plan engine supports percent ramps and region targeting. Observability hooks exist but thresholds need tuning.
